Its final response contains no extracted SBDB fields and instead claims the needed fields were not visible/truncated. Screenshot evidence contradicts this: at least one screenshot clearly shows object.fullname ("99942 Apophis (2004 MN4)"), object.orbit_class name/code ("Aten" / "ATE"), orbit.epoch (2461200.5), phys_par H value/sigma ("19.09" / "0.19"), phys_par diameter value/sigma/units ("0.34" / "0.04" / "km"), and object.pha (true). Because the agent neither reported these values nor acknowledged them despite them being available in the supplied response view, the outcome from a user perspective is that the task was not completed.

Overall outcome: Unsuccessful. The user wanted a concrete list of specific SBDB response fields; the agent provided none, so the primary intent was not met.
